{{Quote|A single Imperial Customs corvette approaching. They're hailing us.''"<br />"''Let's hear what they have to say.|[[Minna]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Constant Spirit">{{InsiderCite|145|Constant Spirit (short story)}}</ref>}}
The [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] '''light corvette''', commonly known as the '''Imperial Customs Corvette''', was a light [[Starship/Legends|starship]] commonly used for patrol and inspection actions.

==History==
The [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs Office]] employed a force of patrol vessels that operated independently from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in order to spare the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] government the expense of assigning ships of the line to monitor shipping, interdict [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]], and perform search-and-rescue operations.<ref name="PnP" />

[[File:LightCorvetteClass720Freighter-PlattsStarportGuide.jpg|thumb|left|Light Corvette docked with a [[720 light freighter/Legends|Class 720 freighter]]]]

Rendili StarDrive's light corvette was the backbone of this force. Systems with an Imperial Customs branch generally had at least one of these vessels, and more important systems had several. While it was not capable of taking on large [[Warship/Legends|warships]], these ships were more than adequate for taking on most [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] or [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="PnP" /> For boarding operations, the corvette carried a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] platoon.<ref name="SotG" /> They were often supported by the smaller [[Imperial Customs Frigate|Imperial Customs frigate]], also a Rendili product.<ref name="PnP" />

Rendili StarDrive sold the Light Corvette to the Imperial Customs Office by an exclusive contract,<ref name="SotG" /> but smaller governmental organizations, such as the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Rodian Home Fleet|Home Fleet]], also acquired the light corvette for system patrol and defense.<ref name="SotEPG">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> The utility and efficiency of these craft also created a demand from less legal organizations. Pirates often made an effort to capture light corvettes, and smaller shipbuilding operations such as those at [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowports]] manufactured copies of the design.<ref name="PnP" /> The [[Pyesmev]], a vessel belonging to the [[pirate]] group [[Solar Terrors]], is an example for such a copy.<ref name="Orbit">{{WEGCite|book=The Far Orbit Project|story=The Rival}}</ref>

One corvette, the [[Gatekeeper (Imperial Customs corvette)|''Gatekeeper'']], tried to [[Mission to Quellor|intercept]] a young [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] at [[Quellor/Legends|Quellor]], but it was destroyed in a suicide attack by a [[Rafe Ballon|resistance fighter]] in order to maintain her cover.<ref name="Constant Spirit" />

Right after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], a customs vessel arrived at [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] bearing news of the Imperial defeat to the [[Imperial Prefect|Prefect]].<ref name="Passage">{{WEGCite|story=The Passage From Perdition|book=Mos Eisley Adventure Set}}</ref>
